map.三点常见代价：体积变大（字符串加密与控制流平坦化会显著膨胀）、性能下降（额外跳转: Three common costs: larger size (string encoding and control-flow flattening inflate the output significantly), lower performance (extra jumps and decoding), and harder debugging (stack traces are hard to map, so keep a source map that is not public). map.先把字符串与正则字面量抽出，替换为 __TK序号__ 占位符（模板串按反引号配对: First extract string and regex literals and replace them with __TK<n>__ placeholders (template strings scanned by backtick pairing, regexes decided by whether the previous non-empty character is an operator/bracket, etc.), then fill them back in placeholder order. Obfuscation transforms: characters in strings with code < 128, not 0, and not the quote itself are rewritten as \xHH two-digit hex; standalone decimal integers (skipping 0 and existing 0x prefixes) are rewritten as uppercase 0x hex; variable renaming excludes reserved words and built-ins such as Array/Math/JSON/window/document/console, and new names are _0x plus 4–5 random hex digits, replaced in descending original-name length to avoid collisions; string array conversion puts deduplicated contents into a randomly named array and replaces occurrences with index references; optionally remove comments and compress whitespace.
